text: 你好，欢迎使用 OrTTS。本地语音合成，让交流更加自然。
measurement: One request per profile in separate app launches; i8mm then baseline; includes PCM callback time, excludes model creation and asset verification; frequency unlocked; no acoustic quality review

long_text_test.text: 清晨的阳光洒在安静的街道上，早餐店已经开始营业。小朋友背着书包走向学校，大人们匆匆赶往车站。今天我们计划乘坐火车前往海边，沿途欣赏山川和田野。出发之前，请检查车票、身份证和随身行李，确认手机电量充足，并提前查看天气变化。如果途中遇到任何问题，请及时联系工作人员，不要独自离开车站。希望每一位旅客都能享受这段轻松愉快的旅程，平安到达目的地。
long_text_test.limitations: Single request per variant, P3 then P5, unlocked frequency, no baseline same-text comparison, playback queue drained; no listening review or underrun measurement

long_text_baseline_test.limitations: Single request per variant; baseline measured after optimization tests and a lock-screen pause; output lengths differ. P3 audio at generation limit; EOS and spoken completeness not verified. RTF comparison is not fixed-output throughput.
